hotspots.name: Back to Camp
hotspots.interactionText: You head back out to camp. Bye, Hangout House!

hotspots.name: Comfy Couch
hotspots.description: Something shiny is stuck in the cushions...
hotspots.interactionText: You flop onto the squishy couch. FLOOMPH! The cushions puff up all around you. So comfy! 🛋️

uses.text: You snuggle into the couch with a big bowl of popcorn. MOVIE NIGHT! 🍿
You sit Teddy Bear on the couch next to you. Best hangout buddy EVER! 🧸
You add your pillow to the couch. Now it's a pillow FORT! 🛏️
You stretch out on the couch and read your book. Just one more chapter... 📚
You sip hot cocoa on the couch. Warm, cozy, and chocolatey! ☕

hotspots.name: Board Game Table
hotspots.description: A board game is all set up!
hotspots.interactionText: You roll the dice... a SIX! You zoom six spaces and land on the ladder all the way to the top! 🎲

uses.text: You build the puzzle on the table. The last piece goes in... CLICK! It's a picture of the camp! 🧩
Popcorn AND a board game? That's the best game night ever! 🍿🎲
You share cookies with everyone at game night. Everybody wins! 🍪
You draw your own board game with crayons. It has rainbows, dragons AND a waterslide! 🖍️

hotspots.name: Game Shelf
hotspots.interactionText: The shelf is PACKED with games: Checkers, Memory, Snakes and Ladders, Bingo... which one should we play first? 🎲

uses.text: You put the cards back in their box on the shelf. Neat and tidy! 🃏
You put the dice back in the game box... and it rolls right back out! Ha ha! 🎲
You look closely at the shelf and find a tiny secret game hiding behind the others! 🔍

hotspots.name: Snack Bar
hotspots.interactionText: You grab a handful of popcorn and munch away. CRUNCH CRUNCH! Snack time is the best time! 🍿

uses.text: You fill your plate with popcorn, pretzels and grapes. A SNACK MOUNTAIN! 🍽️
You cut the apple into snack-size slices for everyone. Crunchy! 🍎
You pour juice for all your friends. Cheers! 🧃

hotspots.name: Toy Chest
hotspots.interactionText: You lift the heavy lid... it's FULL of toys: a teddy bear, a yo-yo, a choo-choo train and a kite! 🧸🚂

uses.text: Teddy Bear meets all the other toys. It's a TOY PARTY! 🧸🎉
You add the rubber duck to the toy chest. Quack! It's the captain of the toys now. 🦆
You bounce the soccer ball into the toy chest. GOAL! ⚽

hotspots.name: Bean Bag
hotspots.interactionText: You jump into the bean bag. SPLOOSH! It swallows you up like a big squishy marshmallow! 😄

uses.text: You drive the toy train in circles around the bean bag. CHOO CHOO! 🚂
You do yo-yo tricks from the bean bag. Walk the dog... AROUND THE WORLD! 🪀
You put the sleeping bag on the bean bag. The SQUISHIEST nap spot in camp! 💤
You snack on grapes in the bean bag. One for you... one for you... 🍇

npcs.name: Pancake
npcs.what: a fluffy orange cat who lives in the red Hangout House and naps on the couch
npcs.personality: Sleepy, cuddly and a little silly. Loves naps in the warm spot on the couch, board games (always wants to be the dice), chasing yo-yos and the sound of popcorn popping. Purrs a lot and sometimes yawns in the middle of a sentence. Kind, encouraging and always happy to have visitors.

hello: Purrr... oh! Hi, {name}! Welcome to the Hangout House! 🐱
Mrrow! {name}! Want to play a board game? I'll be the dice!
*yaaawn* Hi hi! You found the comfiest house in camp.
bye: Bye, {name}! Come back for game night! 🎲
Purr... see you soon! I'll keep the couch warm for you.
Meow! Bye bye! Take a snack for the road!
question: Hmm... I think the answer is NAPS. It's usually naps. 😸
Good question! Let's ask the dice. *roll roll*... it says YES!
Mrrow? I'm not sure. But I'm sure it would be fun to find out!
any: Did somebody say popcorn? 🍿 My ears are listening!
My favorite game is Snakes and Ladders. I always want to be the ladder!
Purrrr... this couch is the best spot in the whole camp.
Want to see my yo-yo trick? I just bat it. Bat bat bat! 🪀
